units.source_text: 柏木的父大臣和母夫人悲伤哭泣，眼泪没有干的时候。

en.t: While Kashiwagi's father, the minister, and his mother were still weeping in grief, before their tears had even dried.

units.source_text: 头七、二七……匆匆过去，他们都茫然不知。

en.t: The first seventh-day service, the second seventh-day service, and so on passed by in haste, and they were too dazed to notice.

units.source_text: 超荐功德、布施供养，以及一切丧事，都由柏木的诸弟妹料理。

en.t: The meritorious rites for his repose, the almsgiving and offerings, and all the funeral arrangements were handled by Kashiwagi's younger brothers and sisters.

units.source_text: 佛经、佛像的装饰布置，则由左大弁红梅指挥。

en.t: The decoration and arrangement of the sutras and Buddhist images were directed by Kobai, the Left Major Controller.

units.source_text: 关于每一个七的诵经事宜，左右人等向大臣请示，

en.t: As for the sutra readings for each seventh-day memorial, the people around them asked the minister for instructions,
The minister replied, "Do not come and ask me!

units.source_text: 我已经悲伤得这样了，再要我操劳，反而增加他的罪孽，妨碍他死后超生。”

en.t: I am already grieving like this; if you make me trouble myself as well, it will only add to his sins and hinder his rebirth after death."

units.source_text: 他已经神志昏迷，似乎濒于死亡了。

en.t: His mind had already grown clouded, and he seemed to be on the verge of death.
